lore: Every island in the census must be stamped with the harbour seal before its cargo can sail, and the seal is cut into one face of a cube too heavy to lift. Sealwright Cornelius tips it across the cobbles, edge over edge, and the seal turns with every tip. Land it seal-up on each island's chalk mark, then bring it to rest on the dock.

lines.true: Every mark stamped clean and the cube on the dock in par tips. A true roll.
lines.wobbly: All stamped, but the cube wandered. Count how the seal turns before you tip.
lines.off_mark: A mark still bare, or the cube is off the dock. Tip it round until the seal comes up.
